detail.longDescription: If you're managing a project that's a bit too complex for a to-do list app but not complex enough that it requires a full-on project management app, you're looking for a Kanban app. I've used Kanban apps a lot over the years to manage totally different kinds of projects: as a blog manager to run a content calendar, as the head of a marketing department to manage projects with my team, and I still use it today as a freelancer to juggle projects and clients.
